name: Rodrick
source: When the protagonist was younger, he was the leader of the group of bullies who bullied him and [url=https://vndb.org/c134425]Sunny[/url] for being an elf, but as he got older, he became an alcoholic who always skipped work and hung out in the tavern.
translation: When the protagonist was younger, he was the leader of the group of bullies who bullied him and [url=https://vndb.org/c134425]Sunny[/url] for being an elf, but as he got older, he became an alcoholic who always skipped work and hung out in the tavern.
